title: [main] Report 11564, Foreign Currency Layout: foreign currency opening balance is not included
summary: Report 11564 now correctly includes foreign currency opening balances for G/L accounts with multiple registered source currencies, fixing previously understated running FCY balances.
key_points: Opening balance for accounts with multiple registered source currencies was incorrectly set to 0 instead of summing balances across all currencies
New helper method CalcSourceCurrencyOpeningBalance() calculates opening balance by summing across all registered currencies when source currency code is blank
Test coverage added for accounts with multiple registered source currencies
quote: Opening balance was looked up via the account's single Source Currency Code field, which is blank for Multiple Currencies accounts
